notes.subject: wena
notes.rationale: Seheberu se bowa ka boemedi fela (יודוך), 'wena' se okeditšwe go hlaloša mang

notes.subject: go leboga
notes.rationale: ידה e ile go tšwa go 'go laša ka seatla' — go leboga ke go bolela ka boikoetšo bokgabo bja go dumelela

notes.subject: חסידיך / חסד
notes.rationale: Ba 'bao ba nago le botho' ba bolela hesede ya D2 — go tšwa modung o tee le botho bjalo ka go v9

translation: Mešomo ya gagwe ka moka e tla go leboga, wena Yahwe, gomme bao ba nago le botho ba gagwe ba tla go lalediša.

tokens.gloss: gomme bao ba nago le botho ba gagwe
